story.title: Set the scene
story.body: Bayern’s club timeline moves from its early success into the modern European era. The 1970s became a defining period as domestic titles and European Cups brought a Munich side onto the continent’s biggest stage.

story.title: Remember the detail
story.body: The club’s milestones point to 1974, 1975 and 1976 as a three-year European Cup run. Those wins made the team of Beckenbauer, Maier and Müller a lasting reference point.

facts.label: First European Cup
facts.prompt: In what year did Bayern win its first European Cup?
facts.evidence: The club timeline lists Bayern as European Cup winners in 1974.

facts.label: Consecutive European wins
facts.prompt: How many European Cups did Bayern win consecutively from 1974 through 1976?
facts.evidence: The timeline records titles in 1974, 1975 and 1976.

facts.label: First Bundesliga title
facts.prompt: In what year did Bayern win their first Bundesliga championship?
facts.evidence: The club history identifies 1969 as the first Bundesliga title.

story.title: Set the scene
story.body: Jupp Heynckes’s Bayern turned the 2012/13 season into the club’s first treble: Bundesliga, DFB Cup and Champions League. A strong league campaign had its title wrapped up early.

story.title: Remember the detail
story.body: The European final at Wembley against Borussia Dortmund supplied the season’s defining night. Arjen Robben scored the late winner, sealing the Champions League and completing the set.

facts.prompt: On which matchday did Bayern secure the 2012/13 Bundesliga title?
facts.evidence: Bayern’s historic treble account says the first trophy was secured after 28 Bundesliga games.

facts.evidence: The club account describes the Wembley final against Borussia Dortmund.

facts.label: Treble season

facts.evidence: The milestone chapter names 2012/13 as the historic treble season.

lessons.title: Bayern · five goals in nine minutes
lessons.subtitle: On 22 September 2015, Bayern trailed Wolfsburg at half-time. Robert Lewandowski entered from th

story.title: Set the scene
story.body: On 22 September 2015, Bayern trailed Wolfsburg at half-time. Robert Lewandowski entered from the bench and changed the match in a burst that became one of the Bundesliga’s most famous scoring feats.

story.title: Remember the detail
story.body: His goals came in minutes 51, 52, 54, 57 and 60. The five-goal spell turned a 0–1 deficit into a 5–1 Bayern win.

facts.label: Opponent
facts.prompt: Which team was Bayern playing when Lewandowski scored five times in nine minutes?
facts.evidence: The official match report identifies Wolfsburg as Bayern’s opponent.

facts.label: First goal minute
facts.prompt: In which minute did Lewandowski score the first of his five goals?
facts.evidence: The match report lists his goals in the 51st, 52nd, 54th, 57th and 60th minutes.

facts.label: Match result
facts.prompt: What was the final score of Bayern’s match against Wolfsburg?
facts.evidence: The official report headline and scoreline give Bayern 5, Wolfsburg 1.

story.title: Set the scene

story.title: Remember the detail
story.body: The Champions League final paired Dortmund with defending champions Juventus in Munich. Dortmund won 3–1, becoming the first German club to win the competition in its then-current Champions League format.

facts.label: Four-goal match date
facts.prompt: On what date did Schick score four goals against Greuther Fürth?
facts.evidence: Bayer’s match report dates the record win to 4 December 2021.

facts.label: Four-goal opponent
facts.prompt: Against which club did Schick score four in a Bundesliga match?
facts.evidence: The club report identifies Greuther Fürth as the opponent.

facts.label: Scoring milestone
facts.prompt: What distinction did Schick achieve with those four goals?
answers: First Bayer 04 player to score four goals in a Bundesliga match
distractors: First Bayer player with a hat-trick in Europe
First Bayer player to score five in a match
Fastest Bayer goal in Bundesliga history

value.display: First Bayer 04 player to score four goals in a Bundesliga match
value.text: First Bayer 04 player to score four goals in a Bundesliga match

facts.evidence: Bayer says Schick was the first club player to score four in a Bundesliga match.

lessons.title: Philipp Lahm · longevity and honours
lessons.subtitle: The lasting scale of a two-decade Bayern career

story.title: A long Bayern chapter
story.body: Lahm spent more than twenty years connected to Bayern, beginning in the youth ranks and ending his playing career at 33.

story.title: A collection of titles
story.body: Across 22 years with the club, he won 21 honours. The count shows the scale of the era he helped lead.

facts.label: Honours
facts.prompt: How many honours did Lahm win during his 22 years with Bayern?
facts.scope: Bayern honours across Lahm’s 22-year connection to the club.
facts.evidence: Bayern’s Hall of Fame opens by noting he won 21 honours in 22 years with the club.

facts.label: Retirement age
facts.prompt: How old was Lahm when he ended his playing career?
facts.scope: Age at end of playing career.
facts.evidence: Bayern says he left a huge pair of shoes to fill at the end of his career aged 33.

facts.label: Bayern connection
facts.prompt: For how many years did Lahm have a connection with Bayern?
facts.scope: Youth and senior connection to Bayern.
facts.evidence: Bayern describes his honours over 22 years with the club.

lessons.title: Bastian Schweinsteiger · from youth to first team
lessons.subtitle: A teenage academy arrival grew into the Bayern senior side

story.title: Youth move
story.body: At 13, Schweinsteiger moved from TSV 1860 Rosenheim to Bayern’s Säbener Straße academy. He collected titles with both the U17 and U19 teams.

story.title: First-team step
story.body: The midfielder made his first-team debut at 18. His path from academy player to a central figure in the senior team started early.

facts.label: Academy arrival
facts.prompt: How old was Schweinsteiger when he joined Bayern from TSV 1860 Rosenheim?
facts.evidence: The official Hall of Fame biography says he moved to Bayern at age 13.

facts.label: Youth championships
facts.prompt: How many Bayern youth age groups did Schweinsteiger win a German championship with?
facts.scope: He won German titles with both U17 and U19.
facts.evidence: The biography says he won the German league title with the U19 and U17.

facts.label: First-team debut age
facts.prompt: How old was Schweinsteiger when he made his Bayern first-team debut?
facts.evidence: The biography says the midfielder made his first-team debut at age 18.
